basic_details.job_title: RRC North Western Railway Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 2008 Posts
basic_details.organization_name: North Western Railway (NWR), Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Jaipur
basic_details.job_location: Workshops/Units under NWR (Ajmer, Bikaner, Jaipur, Jodhpur divisions)

application_fee.details: Fee payment is made online through the payment gateway integrated with the online application, using debit card, credit card, Internet Banking, or similar modes, after the application form is completed and verified for correctness; no change/edit is allowed after fee payment. Any transaction charges for online payment are borne by the candidate. On successful payment, an e-receipt is generated, which should be printed and retained.

age_limit.details: SC/ST candidates: 5 years' relaxation in upper age limit. OBC candidates: 3 years' relaxation in upper age limit. Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD): 10 years' relaxation in upper age limit. Ex-servicemen: relaxable by up to an additional 10 years, to the extent of service rendered in the Defence Forces plus 3 years, provided a minimum of 6 months' continuous service was completed (this does not apply to ex-servicemen who have already joined government service on the civil side after availing ex-servicemen status for that engagement).

qualification.details: Candidates must have passed the Class 10 examination or its equivalent (under the 10+2 examination system) with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate (no rounding off) from a recognised Board, and must also possess a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the notified trade, issued by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) or State Council for Vocational Training (SCVT). Candidates should have the requisite educational/technical qualification from a recognised Board/Government University/Institute as on the date of submission of the application; those awaiting results of their final exams should not apply. | Candidates claiming SC/ST reservation must produce a caste certificate in the Central Government format at the time of Document Verification. OBC candidates must produce a caste certificate and a Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026, in the Central Government format, along with an OBC declaration. EWS candidates must produce an EWS certificate in the prescribed format. Ex-servicemen and Armed Forces Personnel (or their children) must produce a discharge certificate, or an Armed Forces serving certificate in the case of children of serving personnel, at the time of Document Verification. Ex-servicemen candidates are placed in their appropriate category (UR/SC/ST/OBC); if UR vacancies under the Ex-servicemen quota are unavailable, Ex-servicemen belonging to communities where vacancies are available will be considered.

salary_details.details: Training period and stipend will be as per the extant rules and directives issued by the Railway Board from time to time; a specific stipend amount is not stated in this notification. No hostel accommodation will be provided - selected candidates must make their own arrangements during training, as per the Apprentices Act, 1961, and will be released upon completion of training. Before commencing training, the selected candidate (or their guardian, if a minor) must enter into a Contract of Apprenticeship with the employer.

how_to_apply: Candidates must apply online only, by visiting www.rrcjaipur.in, between 7 October 2026 and 6 November 2026 (23:59 hrs). No physical copy of the application needs to be sent to RRC, and any physical copy received will not be given cognisance. The broad process is:

Log in and fill personal details: Log on to the RRC/Jaipur website and carefully fill in personal details/bio-data, including a valid 12-digit Aadhaar Card number (the original Aadhaar card must be produced at Document Verification).

Select one unit only: Candidates must choose only one Division/Unit from the 8 listed, and should carefully check that a training slot exists for their specific ITI trade in that unit before selecting it, since changes are not allowed after final submission.
Upload photograph: A recent colour photograph (3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, not older than 3 months, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, file size 20 KB–70 KB) with a clear front view, without cap or sunglasses.
Upload signature: A scanned signature (3.5 cm × 2.5 cm, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, file size 20 KB–30 KB).

Pay the application fee: Pay the applicable fee (see Fee section above) through the integrated payment gateway, after verifying that all application details are correct, since no changes are allowed after payment.
Download and retain printout: After successful submission, download and keep a printout of the application; this will be required at the time of Document Verification, if shortlisted.

Candidates must ensure their name, father's name, and date of birth exactly match their Matriculation (or equivalent) certificate - any deviation found during Document Verification will lead to cancellation of candidature and debarment. Candidates should also provide an active mobile number and valid email ID, since all important communication will be sent via SMS/email.
important_instructions: Candidates may apply for only one unit; submitting more than one application with different particulars (name, father's name, community, photo, qualification, email, or mobile number) will result in summary rejection of all such applications. The decision of the Railway administration on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, and mode of selection is final. Imparting training on the Railway does not confer any right to absorption/employment on the Railway after successful completion of training; per the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, it is not obligatory for the employer to offer employment, nor for the apprentice to accept it, upon completion of training. No correspondence regarding engagement will be entertained. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature, and no correspondence will be entertained in this regard. Candidates should ensure they fulfil all eligibility criteria before applying; if erroneously engaged, such candidates will be summarily dismissed without notice at any stage. For help with online submission or printing of the application, candidates can call the helpline number published on the website from 7 October 2026, available 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM (except Sundays and holidays) until the last date of application.

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications complete in all respects must be submitted only online by 23:59 hrs on the closing date. Candidates are advised to submit their application well before the closing date to avoid last-minute rush and possible website load issues; RRC does not accept responsibility for candidates unable to submit on account of such issues.

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 2,008 training slots are on offer across 8 units, spanning trades such as Electrician (Coaching/Power/TRD), Fitter, Welder, Carpenter, Painter, Mason, Pipe Fitter, Diesel Mechanic, Turner/Machinist, Electronics Mechanic, Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, Machine Tool Maintenance, and Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, among others. The notification states that the number of training slots shown is provisional and may increase or decrease depending on the administration's actual needs at the time of finalising selection. Note on this article: Each unit's slots are further broken down by trade (e.g. Electrician, Fitter, Welder, Carpenter, Painter, Diesel Mechanic, etc.) and by category (UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS), with separate reserved slots for PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disability) and Ex-servicemen, set out in detailed tables for each of the 8 units in the official notification. Given the scale of this breakdown (dozens of trade rows across 8 separate unit tables), this article presents unit-level totals only; candidates must check the official notification for the exact trade-wise and category-wise slot count for their chosen unit and trade before applying, since a candidate may only select a unit where a training slot exists for their specific ITI trade. When the prescribed number of SC or ST candidates are not available, those reserved training places may be filled by the other of the two (SC by ST, or vice versa); if still unfilled, they may be filled by candidates not belonging to SC/ST. Similarly, seats remaining unfilled by OBC/EWS candidates will be filled by unreserved category candidates. Reserved PwBD and Ex-servicemen seats are not separate or additional - they are already included within the total slots shown for each trade.

Candidates should have the requisite educational/technical qualification from a recognised Board/Government University/Institute as on the date of submission of the application; those awaiting results of their final exams should not apply. Candidates claiming SC/ST reservation must produce a caste certificate in the Central Government format at the time of Document Verification. OBC candidates must produce a caste certificate and a Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026, in the Central Government format, along with an OBC declaration. EWS candidates must produce an EWS certificate in the prescribed format. Ex-servicemen and Armed Forces Personnel (or their children) must produce a discharge certificate, or an Armed Forces serving certificate in the case of children of serving personnel, at the time of Document Verification. Ex-servicemen candidates are placed in their appropriate category (UR/SC/ST/OBC); if UR vacancies under the Ex-servicemen quota are unavailable, Ex-servicemen belonging to communities where vacancies are available will be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is NWR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Notice No. 04/2026 (NWR/AA) from North Western Railway's Railway Recruitment Cell, Jaipur, inviting online applications for 2,008 Act Apprentice training slots under the Apprentices Act, 1961, across 8 units for the year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NWR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2,008 training slots across 8 units: DRM Office Ajmer (500), DRM Office Bikaner (524), DRM Office Jaipur (580), DRM Office Jodhpur (134), B.T.C. Carriage Ajmer (101), B.T.C. LOCO Ajmer (69), Carriage Workshop Bikaner (33), and Carriage Workshop Jodhpur (67).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NWR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closing date is 6 November 2026, until 23:59 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NWR Act Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 10 (or equivalent) with a minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognised Board, and hold a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the relevant trade from NCVT/SCVT.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NWR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 15 and 24 years of age as on 6 November 2026, with age relaxation available for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, and Ex-servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the NWR Act Apprentice application fee?
faq.answer: ₹100 (non-refundable) for all candidates except SC/ST, PwBD, and Women candidates, who are exempt from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for NWR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only at www.rrcjaipur.in between 7 October 2026 and 6 November 2026, as described in the How to Apply section above.

faq.question: Q8. What is the NWR Act Apprentice selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a merit list calculated as the simple average of Matriculation percentage and ITI percentage marks, prepared separately for each division/unit, trade, and community, as explained in the Selection Process section above.
